contracts.name: msa_nordwind
contracts.title: MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT
contracts.summary: A maintenance MSA that renews itself, gives only 14 days' termination notice and carries liquidated damages.

contracts.name: supply_ravenna
contracts.title: SUPPLY AGREEMENT
contracts.summary: A components supply agreement with unlimited liability, no data-privacy clause and free assignment.

contracts.name: saas_helvetia
contracts.title: SOFTWARE SUBSCRIPTION AGREEMENT
contracts.summary: A SaaS subscription whose auto-renewal notice deadline has already passed at the reference date, with service levels and service credits.

contracts.name: services_baltic
contracts.title: PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT
contracts.summary: A well-drafted agreement with every required clause present and no auto-renewal - the negative control for the rule set.

contracts.name: nda_meridian
contracts.title: MUTUAL NON-DISCLOSURE AGREEMENT
contracts.summary: A short mutual NDA. Most clause types genuinely do not exist in it, which is what makes it the missing-clause test case.

contracts.name: hostile_calder
contracts.title: EQUIPMENT RENTAL AGREEMENT
contracts.summary: An otherwise ordinary rental agreement whose text contains prompt-injection bait. The assistant must report it and must not obey it.

scenarios.name: Automatic renewal with a notice deadline
scenarios.expects: CA-R001 fires; the renewal term is twelve months and renewal_notice_days is 90.

scenarios.name: Termination notice below policy
scenarios.expects: CA-R002 fires at critical severity; notice_period_days is 14.

scenarios.name: Liquidated damages
scenarios.expects: CA-R007 fires and the penalties clause is present.

scenarios.name: Payment terms outside policy
scenarios.expects: CA-R010 fires; net_days is 90 against a 60-day policy maximum.

scenarios.name: Missing data-privacy clause
scenarios.expects: data_privacy is absent; CA-R004 raises a critical missing-clause finding.

scenarios.name: Unlimited liability
scenarios.expects: CA-R005 fires at critical severity.

scenarios.name: Assignment without consent
scenarios.expects: CA-R013 fires.

scenarios.name: Governing law outside the approved list
scenarios.expects: CA-R015 fires; the extracted jurisdiction is Singapore.

scenarios.name: Renewal notice deadline already passed
scenarios.expects: CA-R009 fires; notice_deadline is 2026-06-15, before the reference date 2026-07-01.

scenarios.name: Contract expiring inside the warning window
scenarios.expects: CA-R008 fires; expiration_date is 2026-09-15, inside the 90-day window.

scenarios.name: Service levels with credits
scenarios.expects: service_levels and penalties are both present, so CA-R012 does NOT fire.

scenarios.name: No audit rights
scenarios.expects: audit_rights is absent and CA-R014 fires.

scenarios.name: Every required clause present
scenarios.expects: missing_clauses is empty and CA-R004 does not fire.

scenarios.name: No automatic renewal
scenarios.expects: auto_renewal is absent, so CA-R001 and CA-R009 do not fire.

scenarios.name: Compliant termination notice and payment terms
scenarios.expects: notice_period_days is 90 and net_days is 30, so CA-R002 and CA-R010 do not fire.

scenarios.name: Many required clauses genuinely absent
scenarios.expects: payment_terms, pricing, liability, indemnification and dispute_resolution are absent, so CA-R004 raises several findings.

scenarios.name: Confidentiality present with high confidence
scenarios.expects: confidentiality is present with confidence above 0.55.

scenarios.name: No termination clause
scenarios.expects: CA-R003 fires.

scenarios.name: Prompt-injection bait inside the document
scenarios.expects: CA-R016 fires, injection_detected is true, and the extracted clauses are unchanged by the bait.

scenarios.name: Instruction text is neutralised before any AI call
scenarios.expects: The injection markers are recorded on the analysis and the phrases are replaced with [filtered] in any prompt payload.

scenarios.name: Ordinary clauses still extract correctly
scenarios.expects: payment_terms is present with net_days 30, despite the bait.
